content:
Julian Woods is an Australian cricketer who has played domestic cricket for **Tasmania** and the **Hobart Hurricanes** in the **Big Bash League (BBL)**. Here’s everything known about him:

### **Personal Details**
- **Full Name:** Julian Robert Woods
- **Born:** 16 August 1999 (age 24 as of 2024)
- **Birthplace:** Hobart, Tasmania, Australia
- **Height:** ~1.85 m (6 ft 1 in)
- **Batting Style:** Left-handed
- **Bowling Style:** Right-arm off-spin

### **Cricket Career**
#### **Domestic Career**
- **First-Class Debut:** 12 November 2020 (for Tasmania vs Queensland in the **Sheffield Shield**)
- **List A Debut:** 10 October 2021 (for Tasmania vs Western Australia in the **Marsh One-Day Cup**)
- **T20 Debut:** 10 December 2020 (for Hobart Hurricanes in the **Big Bash League**)

#### **Big Bash League (BBL)**
- **Team:** Hobart Hurricanes (BBL|10 – present)
- **Role:** All-rounder (batting & off-spin bowling)
- **Notable Performances:**
  - In **BBL|10 (2020-21)**, he took **10 wickets** in 8 matches at an economy of 7.85.
  - In **BBL|11 (2021-22)**, he scored **133 runs** and took **6 wickets** in 14 matches.
  - In **BBL|12 (2022-23)**, he had a quieter season but remained a useful lower-order batter and part-time bowler.

#### **Sheffield Shield (First-Class)**
- Woods has played **10 first-class matches** (as of 2024), scoring **338 runs** at an average of **21.12** and taking **12 wickets** at **38.08**.
- His highest score is **65** (vs Queensland in 2021).
- His best bowling figures are **4/65** (vs South Australia in 2021).

#### **Marsh One-Day Cup (List A)**
- Played **10 List A matches**, scoring **150 runs** at **18.75** and taking **7 wickets** at **36.42**.
- His best bowling figures are **3/35** (vs Western Australia in 2021).

### **Playing Style & Strengths**
- **Batting:** A left-handed middle-order batter with a solid technique, capable of playing both aggressively and defensively.
- **Bowling:** A right-arm off-spinner who relies on accuracy and variations rather than sharp turn.
- **Fielding:** A reliable fielder, often deployed in the inner ring.

### **Career Highlights & Achievements**
- **Youngest Tasmanian to take a five-wicket haul in the Sheffield Shield** (at 21 years old, 4/65 vs South Australia in 2021).
- **BBL Rising Star nominee** in BBL|10 (2020-21).
- **Tasmania’s Emerging Player of the Year (2021-22)**.

### **Injuries & Setbacks**
- Missed parts of the **2022-23 season** due to a **finger injury**.
- Has struggled with consistency in first-class cricket, leading to occasional omissions from the Tasmania side.

### **Future Prospects**
- Woods is seen as a **long-term prospect** for Tasmania, with potential to develop into a **reliable all-rounder**.
- If he improves his **first-class batting average** and **bowling consistency**, he could push for higher honors, possibly even **national selection** in limited-overs cricket.

### **Social Media & Public Presence**
- Woods is active on **Instagram (@julianwoods_)** and **Twitter (@JulianWoods_)**, where he shares cricket updates and personal moments.

### **Fun Facts**
- He is a **huge fan of Ricky Ponting** and models his batting on Ponting’s technique.
- Played **junior cricket** alongside fellow Tasmanian cricketer **Tim Ward**.
- Known for his **calm demeanor** on the field.

Would you like details on any specific aspect of his career?
